channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Injury Expanded
item.description: An Injury, Diagnosis and Treatment system

item.title: Holdfast
item.description: Found a town. Hire workers. Watch it grow one building at a time.

item.title: More Saplings!
item.description: Makes trees drop 3–15 saplings based on leaves, making forests easier to replant.

item.title: UniversalChat
item.description: Adds a native Universal chat tab that mirrors General and translates each message locally.

item.title: Cozy Pierzynas
item.description: Adds new uses for feathers. Pillows and duvets in many colors.

item.title: Player Model NPCs
item.description: Placeable NPCs that can use any PlayerModelLib model, plus in-game activity and dialogue editor

item.title: Extreme Weathers [ALPHA]
item.description: Introduces new extreme weather events. Blizzards, sandstorms, tornadoes, hurricanes and more!

item.title: Furio's Telescope
item.description: Functional Telescopes with celestial body Observation Mechanic.

item.title: BNI Essentials
item.description: Essential game play enhancing features and tweaks for the Batteries Not Included community server.

item.title: Async Handbook Filter
item.description: Fixes handbook freeze/crash on modpacks with many cooking mods (ACulinaryArtillery etc.)

item.title: Vintage Rift - Client
item.description: Client only code for the Vintage Rift server

item.title: Earthfed - More Fertilizers
item.description: Realistic fertilizers made from feathers, seaweed, fish, and blood

item.title: NDL ExpandedGrowth (Tree Growth Module)
item.description: Adds a method for growing larger variants of trees.

item.title: Solaria's Sauce
item.description: Foliage theme pack

item.title: Wootsteel
item.description: Rediscovering forgotten metallurgy techniques

item.title: Firstaidkits
item.description: Adds in functional first aid kits to fix larger more serious injuries. Now comes with splints!

item.title: Desert Tweaks
item.description: small set of tweaks for a desert survival server

item.title: Arctic Survival
item.description: Tweaks for colder climate / Snowball Earth playthroughs

item.title: VS Terrain Diffusion
item.description: Generate terrain with a neural heightmap model trained on real Earth topography

item.title: Better Fruit Press and Still
item.description: Makes the fruit press quicker and allows squeezing over barrels.

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: Feral Kinship: Companions
item.description: Turns tamed foxes into full companions with perks, moods, packs, expeditions, and more.

item.title: Yeet! Reborn
item.description: Press a key (default: Y) to toss your selected item over the horizon! Ctrl+Y throws the whole stack.

item.title: AstraTerra
item.description: Turns the night sky into an dynamic starfield, create and monitor your own constellations.

item.title: Blood Fennel Compatibility
item.description: Bridges my two mods, "More Blood Thingies," and "Fennel Swag."

item.title: Fennel Swag
item.description: Adds some features for fennel because it isn't any good

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Taming
item.description: Adds taming ability through PetAI to allow a bunch of the FOTSA animals to be tamed.

item.title: Rift Traveler
item.description: Explore or close rifts, craft temporal tech, teleport home, and transmit cargo across dimensions

item.title: Obsidiancraft
item.description: Adds new obsidian items, including crude arrows, saws, scythes, macuahuitl and tepoztopilli

item.title: Crown & Coalition Chapter 2
item.description: Chapter 2 additions for C&C.
